testedBuilds.scope: Official Linux x64 runtime against native Android via disposable authenticated HTTPS fixtures; production routes and paid model providers remain operator acceptance gates

constraints: Exact version gate; no fallback to other releases
System-trusted HTTPS root origin and shared server password with explicit per-machine acknowledgement
No browser-based Cloudflare Access or service-token header integration
No automatic retry of uncertain mutations
No per-device revocation; unresolved sends block local credential replacement
Bounded durable transcript; unsupported state-changing events fail closed
No file attachments, slash commands, arbitrary file browser, terminal, cloud provisioning or iOS
